verdict.rationale: Stablecoin settlement is a fair question for an agentic payments product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence mentions stablecoins or crypto rails. The documented settlement paths are Braintree delegated tokens (ACP), Google Pay tokens via Braintree (UCP), and PayPal Orders v2 / Store Sync in USD, all priced at standard card and PayPal checkout fees.
